channel.description: Local news for Martin, St. Lucie and Indian River counties, Florida.

item.description:
Four people accused in an armed robbery of a teenager were arrested in Martin County after a pursuit, according to deputies. The arrests occurred Monday following the incident involving the teenage victim.

item.title: 40-year-old driver killed in head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County
item.description: A 40-year-old man was killed early Sunday after a head-on crash on State Road 710 in Martin County, according to the Florida Highway Patrol. item.title: Peacock House Art Foundation transforms Fort Pierce into artistic destination with history and global artists
item.description: The Peacock House Art Foundation is transforming Fort Pierce into an artistic destination, putting the Peacock Arts District on the map and connecting local and international artists at the historic Crain Estate.

item.title: Port St. Lucie works to expand Midway Road, add partial Florida Turnpike interchange
item.description: Port St. Lucie City Council last month approved the first reading of an ordinance to give 7 acres of land to the Florida Department of Transportation to assist with a partial interchange coming to Florida's Turnpike in St. Lucie County.

item.title: Hobe Sound community rallies around man who lost fiance in deadly home fire
item.description: A Hobe Sound man is leaning on his community after losing his fiance Misty Dawn White, 46, who was found dead Monday after a fire broke out inside the couple's home.

item.title: St. Lucie County marine deputies rescue 2 after boat sinks in Intracoastal Waterway
item.description: St. Lucie County Sheriff's Office Marine Unit rescued two boaters after their small motorized boat took on water and became submerged in the Intracoastal Waterway on July 1.

item.title: Stuart downtown dock closes Monday for $3 million renovation that will nearly double slip capacity
item.description: Stuart's downtown public dock will close July 6 for a $3 million renovation projected to be complete by next Fourth of July. item.title: Serena Williams withdraws from Wimbledon doubles with sister Venus due to knee injury
item.description: Serena Williams pulled out of her doubles match with sister Venus at Wimbledon on Saturday after a right knee injury sustained during her singles return earlier in the week.

item.title: Argentina beats Cape Verde 3-2 in extra time to advance to World Cup Round of 16
item.description: Lionel Messi and Argentina survived a scare from Cape Verde in a thrilling match that went to extra time before the defending World Cup champion advanced to face Egypt.

item.title: United States seeks quarterfinal spot against Belgium with Balogun cleared to play
item.description: The host United States is seeking to reach the World Cup quarterfinals for the first time since 2002 when it faces Belgium on Monday in Seattle with forward Folarin Balogun now cleared to play.

item.description:
